image_description: A close-up view of a bicycle wheel hub featuring a mechanical disc brake system. The image shows a silver, ventilated steel rotor with cross-drilled holes and curved cooling vanes. A black and silver caliper assembly is mounted to the fork dropout, clamping onto the rotor. Silver spokes radiate from the central hub, and a portion of the silver bicycle fork is visible at the top.
